info.title: docusign (WorkflowBench simulated)
info.description: Simulated docusign API for benchmarking. Derived from public documentation; no live service is called.

post.summary: Create and optionally dispatch an envelope. Builds a new envelope from a template or with inline documents. Set status t
post.description: Create and optionally dispatch an envelope. Builds a new envelope from a template or with inline documents. Set status to 'sent' to deliver immediately or 'created' to save as a draft.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The external account number (int) or account ID GUID.

requestBody.description: {emailSubject: string, emailBlurb: string, status: 'sent'|'created', templateId: string, templateRoles: [{email, name, roleName, tabs: {textTabs: [{tabLabel, value}]}}], documents: [{documentBase64, documentId, fileExtension, name}], recipients: {signers: [{email, name, recipientId, routingOrder}], carbonCopies: [{email, name, recipientId, routingOrder}]}, compositeTemplates: [...]}. Each templateRoles entry may carry a tabs object whose textTabs pre-fill the template's named fields (tabLabel) with the supplied value.

get.summary: Search envelopes and track status changes. Filter by date range, status, folder, or keyword. The from_date parameter is
get.description: Search envelopes and track status changes. Filter by date range, status, folder, or keyword. The from_date parameter is mandatory.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The DocuSign account ID.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Earliest date for the search window (ISO 8601). Required.

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: Latest date for the search window (ISO 8601). Defaults to current time.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated statuses to filter by: completed, created, declined, deleted, delivered, processing, sent, signed, voided.

parameters.name: from_to_status
parameters.description: Qualifies the date range: Changed (default), Created, Delivered, Sent, Signed, Completed, Declined, Voided, Deleted, Processing, or TimedOut.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction: 'asc' or 'desc'.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Field to sort by: 'last_modified', 'created', 'sent', or 'status'.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of envelopes to return (hard max 1000).

parameters.name: start_position
parameters.description: Zero-based offset for pagination.

parameters.name: search_text
parameters.description: Keyword to match against envelope metadata.

parameters.name: folder_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated folder IDs to narrow the search scope.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Additional data to embed: 'custom_fields', 'documents', 'recipients', etc.

200.description: EnvelopesInformation: {envelopes: [Envelope], resultSetSize: string, totalSetSize: string, startPosition: string, endPosition: string, nextUri: string, previousUri: string}

get.summary: Retrieve details for a single envelope, including overall status, sender, recipients, documents, and key timestamps.
get.description: Retrieve details for a single envelope, including overall status, sender, recipients, documents, and key timestamps.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The DocuSign account ID.

parameters.name: envelopeId
parameters.description: GUID of the envelope to retrieve.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of additional resources to embed in the response (e.g. 'recipients', 'documents').

put.summary: Modify an existing envelope. Transition a draft to sent by setting status to 'sent'. Cancel an in-flight envelope by set
put.description: Modify an existing envelope. Transition a draft to sent by setting status to 'sent'. Cancel an in-flight envelope by setting status to 'voided' along with a voidedReason.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The DocuSign account ID.

parameters.name: envelopeId
parameters.description: Identifier of the envelope to modify.

requestBody.description: {status: 'sent'|'voided', voidedReason: string (required when voiding), emailSubject: string, emailBlurb: string}

get.summary: Retrieve all recipients for an envelope, including every signer, CC recipient, and their current status.
get.description: Retrieve all recipients for an envelope, including every signer, CC recipient, and their current status.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The DocuSign account ID.

parameters.name: envelopeId
parameters.description: Identifier of the envelope whose recipients to retrieve.

parameters.name: include_tabs
parameters.description: Set to 'true' to include field/tab details for each recipient.

parameters.name: include_extended
parameters.description: Set to 'true' to include extended recipient details.

post.summary: Append signers or CC recipients to an existing envelope.
post.description: Append signers or CC recipients to an existing envelope.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The DocuSign account ID.

parameters.name: envelopeId
parameters.description: Identifier of the envelope to add recipients to.

requestBody.description: {signers: [{name: string, email: string, recipientId: string, routingOrder: string, roleName: string}], carbonCopies: [{name: string, email: string, recipientId: string, routingOrder: string}]}

uri.description: API resource path for this envelope.

statusDateTime.description: Timestamp of the most recent status change on this envelope.

envelopeId.description: Globally unique identifier for this envelope.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the envelope.

emailSubject.description: Subject line of the notification email sent to signers.

emailBlurb.description: Body text of the notification email sent to signers.

sentDateTime.description: Timestamp when the envelope was dispatched to recipients.

voidedReason.description: Explanation provided when the envelope was voided.

uri.description: API resource path for this envelope.

signers.description: All signers assigned to this envelope.

carbonCopies.description: All carbon copy (CC) recipients on this envelope.

recipientCount.description: Total count of all recipients across all types.

recipientId.description: Identifier that uniquely distinguishes this recipient within the envelope.

name.description: Full name of the person who must sign.

email.description: Email address where the signing invitation is delivered.

status.description: Current state of this recipient: autoresponded, completed, created, declined, delivered, faxPending, sent, or signed.

routingOrder.description: Position in the signing sequence that controls when this recipient receives the envelope.

roleName.description: Template role name mapped to this recipient.

name.description: Full name of the CC recipient.

email.description: Email address of the CC recipient.

routingOrder.description: Position in the routing sequence for this CC recipient.

documentId.description: Numeric identifier for this document within the envelope.

order.description: Position of this document in the envelope's document list.

templateId.description: Globally unique identifier for this template.

description.description: Summary text describing the purpose of this template.

emailSubject.description: Pre-set email subject line applied to envelopes created from this template.

emailBlurb.description: Pre-set email body text for envelopes created from this template.

email.description: Email address of the person assigned to this role.

name.description: Full name of the person assigned to this role.

roleName.description: Name of the role as configured in the template.
